projects.title: Enterprise Cloud Payment Engine
projects.subtitle: High-Throughput Distributed Payment Gateway
projects.description: Distributed payment processing engine handling high-volume transaction workloads with multi-region failover.
projects.longDescription: Engineered event-driven microservices processing over $10M in transactions monthly. Implemented circuit breakers, distributed locking with Redis, and Kafka audit streams.
highlights: Reduced database read load by 65% by implementing multi-level Redis caching.
Zero-downtime deployment pipelines using Kubernetes rolling updates.

projects.title: Real-Time Telemetry Analytics Platform
projects.subtitle: Stream Processing & Monitoring System
projects.description: Real-time analytics dashboard monitoring server cluster metrics, request rates, and error traces.
projects.longDescription: Architected stream processing pipeline capturing logs across 50+ nodes and visualizing real-time metrics on Grafana dashboards.
highlights: Built custom alert triggers dispatching PagerDuty incidents automatically.
Decreased memory footprint per worker node by 40% through garbage collection tuning.

experience.description: Leading the core backend platform squad responsible for cloud microservices and database infrastructure.
achievements: Architected core API platform supporting 2M+ daily active users.
Mentored team of 6 software engineers and conducted quarterly technical design reviews.
Led migration from monolithic application to Docker containerized microservices.

experience.description: Developed RESTful APIs, optimized SQL queries, and integrated third-party payment integrations.
achievements: Optimized slow relational queries resulting in 50% faster API response times.
Implemented JWT authentication and RBAC authorization middleware.
